apps.localizedDescription:
What is it?:

Nyxian is an iOS app that empowers developers with a full toolchain they can use while even being offline for iOS development on iPhone. It supports Swift, C, Objective-C, C++ and Objective-C++. It provides a native on-device build environment, a userspace microkernel, and the tooling to compile, run, and manage app packages without needing a desktop or a jailbroken device.

Core focus: ProcEnvironment/Surface:

Everything I care about is located at Nyxian/LindChain/ProcEnvironment/Surface.

Nyxian:

• Feature: Swift typechecking. (cd5cb95c76d8279a57abc6a4c980dfb0b2c849e0).
• Feature: Ksurface Kernel Extension projects. (cf9fcd92f7c8294e63c4e7cb62ff2853025330a3, 9d97e939a88453e8ad6f769997885b3f7cf95a23, f1539b729cd74f3854c5cd8d77d151b5913cbfe0, ca6f57fa2f3affcd471dc413f18bf3df55e790d2, 76dfdb0589147eb19956b1b6e36dd527d656e4f8, c981c47fcf3ce074c5a30b863ee5a7ade967f909, 1878e1a7cc26066b44f15d4f00a08c5d1356838d).
• Feature: backup and restore app sizing for the entire Nyxian boot session. (39a7dd574647581f96d7dbe3c8480c801a89eb55, 1265add0552cc9e7817709988a89e54dc5d874f9, 075cb37f07f674d9c66317a406b67e4fd1696024).
• Feature: symlinks are now partially supported in the file manager UI. (ddd3782a8279da0e068f0c80e524b80adcd47c0f, 7d76fea8d5555b7d8bb09040a8361c48d57a1d6e).
• Feature: added Get Info panel like in macOS Finder to the file manager UI. (72ddb9fc66b052941bd36c32502fb6c5163c9e75).
• Feature: now bundles and data containers can be easily browsed via a context menu button and the file manager UI. (6db6de99271bd12499b68711da1e92edf169b431).
• Feature: render icons on iOS 26+ with the actual iOS app icon rendering pipeline. (c08e9906d9e33335863825ed64a243d47a0ecd67, de2747bfac2e6d047ea293b9a6237c808034d348, c3bd58512bced6eb9672ee827cc0bee43dc79e46).
• Fix: correctly handling fatal compilation errors. (d82fb79ee49c11395ecb2ec4b7ea358eb446dd24).

CoreCompiler:

• Feature: Swift typechecking. (cd5cb95c76d8279a57abc6a4c980dfb0b2c849e0).
• Fix: patched -fmodules not working due to iOS app HOME path bug. (5073db055dd67c820c157f32ef1786ad7215766e, 942528a52a946f42de7081feb24e630b35364287, 585948fff57546b83e706fc96e79dab8274fdecb, 9437af8bcbb74a45273a7850ae1c65b58b3a0fd6, 19d477e14ed4778229134eae440db529f206826e).
• Fix: refresh language server when user saves options. (76a0544739b654260119b9c8296780646e7c4685).
• Fix: correctly appending MDKDiagnostic object with their absolute path. (08d7d6eff474adad4cc4c64deda051945561366e, 5a1d9da04029b7b0d04acea13ec64af1c1c84299, cf3cf92465369cc1c58fdd7740217fcb7302b28f, 885dabc3657c339e693737aa63cdd43a09363c79).
• Fix: the window server shall not allow full screen processes that exited to make non full screen apps not focusable anymore. (ca217756470f618daea09fc435ee59886de36800).

HWHook:

• Fix: deallocating thread port right after usage. (61343956c243ccc061b75ed6094207198009a92d).

Micro Kernel (ksurface):

• Fix: patched slowness of userspace reboots and daemon reloads. (cdf3cbc43bd6f855781b5450ceb5502f7f6df9f4).

• Vulnerability Fix: patched a mach exception port receive right leak in SYS_handoffep. (a3f8d420e923db7a72cc927c3cce3d04af6bc3fb).
• Vulnerability Fix: patched a uninitialized memory vulnerability in ktfp. (78e45d84bb84fe3ca4dec4c898389b59ac1277d4, eaab4d6f1cb10d2c5a51c7ab732c3403e7689d19).
• Vulnerability Fix: patched a IPC mach message type confusion vulnerability in ktfp. (d161b5e33127f3c3ad741a61ec814eff2052d835).
• Vulnerability Fix: patched a syscall worker exhaustion vulnerability. (a90c98693b5cf21548fa88c84d1f91f225c8e1ed, 8269c96df27bb6c22d5636f83904174fe6238401).
• Vulnerability Fix: patched a task port confusion race condition in syscall worker. (1d06cf544bf5843eb4c785924ff2c61d593e58b0).
• Fix: signing of TSRootBinaries will now happen automatically. (c7f669d734a8452ef487485c00c8bbb32f4b92ae).
• Feature: Handling Apple CS entitlement com.apple.private.MobileContainerManager.allowed and com.apple.private.security.storage.AppBundles in translation to NXT2. (0529b4e13a9b8b855e2eff3a48ed5a4ace6439a1).
• Feature: Handling Apple CS entitlement com.apple.security.exception.files.absolute-path.read-write and com.apple.security.exception.files.absolute-path.read-only in translation to NXT2. (88f8aea91b26a30d7a0b85b7d14fe2953a51b696).
• Feature: Added file system mount preserver. (34c6f806a428c2c3bd573682c88bd3080cad4cbf, 83cb914df17eb160d9031e092a5caba33662ae65, 4ece930cf3f5f9d4dc3f185abda3f2199dd0fd31, aa08ffb8d46a8b1d4e9050ce1046322f936dd1a0, dd064054078657e98277c
